form:FormGroup.label: Destination Feed
form:FormGroup.helpText: Feed that notifications are written to as streams. Administrators can select Set Default to make this feed the default for new notifications.
For streaming rules, write detections to the feed of the stream being processed instead of the destination feed. Disabled and ignored for other processing types.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Streaming rules only. Writes detections to the source stream's feed.

tickbox:CustomCheckBox.label: Use Source Feed If Possible (Streaming Only)
